items.title: Base change for the pushforward along a finite morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves base change for the pushforward along a finite morphism: f'_*(g')^{-1}F = g^{-1}f_*F for any sheaf of sets on X_etale (statement lines 8291-8303). The proof reduces to the affine case by locality and finiteness (proof lines 8305-8320), computes both sides through their sections over the base change (proof lines 8320-8340), and descends the local equality (proof lines 8340-8347). The non-formal content is the affine computation; the argument parallels the integral case with finiteness replacing integrality. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one affine computation.
